user_manual.detail: Installers can select verification per interactive role and test reconciliation against the receiver's native accepted-input events.

reusable_learning.reason: The common completion contract and adapter guide contain the reusable procedure.

validation.cross_process_contract: The common dispatcher invokes the actual common receiver main/library with canonical attempt environment: busy rejection retries safely; accepted input records a string receipt; uncertain input verifies a late native ACK without another presentation.
validation.preservation: Existing owner priority, ordinary FIFO burst allowance, producer event identity and the shared PID/start lock remain covered by the combined regression suite.
